lines.trans: Hello, Viktor Petrovich, good afternoon.
Hello. Yes, hello.
I wanted to say a huge thank-you for the flowers.
You are always welcome for the flowers.
How did you find out they were from me?
Well, how could I not?
Just like you.
Thank you so very much once again.
Well, did you talk to my dad?
And what did you say to him?
Did he speak politely with you?
Are they coming over to our place tomorrow?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you.
на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

молчать.gloss: to be silent, to say nothing

meanings.en: to be silent, to keep quiet
meanings.note: почему ты молчишь? = why aren't you saying anything?

examples.text: Ну что ты молчишь? Ты толстый, ты не спортсмен!
examples.trans: Well, why are you so quiet? You're fat, you're no athlete!

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.en: to communicate, to socialise, to have contact

examples.trans: I am not allowed to talk with you.

examples.text: Мне с вами вообще общаться нельзя. Всего доброго.
examples.trans: I'm not allowed to talk to you at all. Good day.

examples.text: Кстати, если хочешь, иди к нам в команду. Шансы у нас огромные.
examples.trans: By the way, if you want, join our team. Our chances are huge.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
